# Carl Friedrich Gauss — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What field did Carl Friedrich Gauss work in?", "mathematics"),
    ("What is Carl Friedrich Gauss known for?", "number theory, statistics"),
    ("What is lived?", "1777-1855"),
    ("What is field?", "mathematics"),
    ("What is known for?", "number theory, statistics"),
    ("What is note?", "Prince of mathematicians"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
